scope: local only; team roles in web and native app
behavior: Additional team roles require recipient acceptance
Player removes the extra team role immediately
Existing role assignments are not rewritten by the migration
Acceptance rechecks membership, previous role and proposer authority
Revocation cancels pending offers and old invitation tokens
Notifications link to the team with response buttons
activation: Run migration only against an explicitly local database; use updated local web assets and rebuilt app. No real database migrated and no device installation performed.
